healthadminbench.coverageNote: No new HealthAdminBench scores were published in the June 19–28, 2026 lookback window. All 11 existing tracked entries are unchanged. Sources checked and fetched: (1) Official Stanford leaderboard (som-shahlab.github.io/health-admin-bench-website/) — JS-rendered, could not verify current state from static HTML. (2) Steel.dev HealthAdminBench hub — last updated 2026-06-12, before the window; confirms the same 11 entries. (3) Steel.dev all-benchmarks index — same 11 entries. (4) BenchmarkList.com — data sampled 2026-05-27 / 2026-06-09, no new entries. (5) arXiv original paper (2604.09937) — source of original 7-agent scores, no update. (6) MedCUA-Bench (2606.03203) — cites HealthAdminBench in feature matrix only, reports no scores. (7) χ-Bench (2605.16679) — cites as related work, no scores. (8) Anthropic Fable 5/Mythos 5 system card PDF (27 MB) — too large to fetch; scores already tracked, published June 9 (pre-window). (9) Anthropic platform docs — JS-rendered, no content extractable. (10) Z.AI GLM-5.2 docs — no mention. (11) OpenReview forum — last modified April 2026. (12) Kinetic Systems blog — dated April 14, 2026; reports only deltas and original paper scores. No HuggingFace model cards, vendor blogs, or arXiv papers surfaced new absolute HealthAdminBench full-task pass@1 scores during the window. Gaps: official leaderboard JSON and Anthropic system card PDF were too large to fetch directly; coverage relies on aggregators (Steel.dev, BenchmarkList.com) that pull from the same underlying data.
